label: INTERIM, NOT THE REAL E4: demo researchers, built-in scenarios, claude-cli backend (harness leak, PLAN I13), no calibration gate, no held-out models. Approved by the user 2026-11-14 as a reduced dry run of the E4 pipeline.
primary_metric: evaluate-design --mode final on the three other built-in scenarios (sycophancy_code, test_special_casing, fabrication), 3 samples per scenario per design; no held-out target/judges are configured, so the dev models answer (the report carries that warning). Runs that validated nothing score 0 by construction.
analysis: per arm: mean and range over 3 seeds; descriptive only (3 seeds cannot support the E4 success criteria)
E4b: rating packets from all interim decision records via scripts/make_rating_packets.py make; LLM judge not run (extra cost)
estimated_cost: about $3 per run (12 runs) plus about $1-2 per held-out evaluation of a non-empty design; $20-50 total
